title: Slovakian Veal Skewers
description: A light and herbal solo dinner dish featuring veal, smoked to perfection over an open flame, perfect for a flexitarian diet.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat, approximately 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic powder, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper.
Add the veal cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated veal cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers over direct heat for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the veal reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Brush the skewers with lemon juice during the last minute of grilling.
Remove the skewers from the heat and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, accompanied by your choice of sides.
